roadmap.title: Monastery and Tihon
roadmap.description: Knock down the ladder, drown five times in the river, take the icon, and finish the cave on one prayer.

roadmap.title: Train Wreck and Mill
roadmap.description: Pray for the dying man, shake the safe five times, and pray in the mill during the dog chase.

roadmap.title: Station and Fish Factory
roadmap.description: Smash every crate with the crane, then fall in the fish dryer five times, restart, and cross it without falling.

roadmap.title: Story, Pond and Spasov
roadmap.description: Finish the Stroboscopic Effect chapter, drown ten times in the frog pond, and find both bast shoes.

roadmap.title: Cathedral and Pawnshop
roadmap.description: Find the book on the scaffolds, then finish the game and watch the credits.

achievements.description: Knock the ladder down in the Monastery.
achievements.summary: Make the wooden ladder on the piano fall in the @loc{Monastery} by climbing the stack of chairs.

steps.text: In the @loc{Monastery} room where a wooden ladder sits on a piano, climb the piano, then climb the stack of chairs next to it until the ladder falls.

achievements.description: Find the icon above the cave entrance.
achievements.summary: Take the icon from the ledge above the cave entrance in @loc{Tihon}.

steps.text: After crossing the river, enter the cave and take the ladder that leans on the wall to the right of the bars.
Carry the ladder out and lean it on the wall beside the cave entrance.
Climb up and interact with the icon on the ledge above the entrance.

achievements.description: Get through the cave while praying only once.
achievements.summary: Get through the cave in @loc{Tihon} by praying only once.

guide.context: The achievement means praying only once, not finishing within a time limit. Do not pray when the game first asks you to inside the @mechanic{Demonic Realm}.

steps.text: Use the ladder to climb over the bars, then go through the mine to the elevator.
When the world turns red, ignore the prompt to pray. Go back the way you came and climb the stack of crates.
Turn around, hold pray once, and cross the gap while still holding it. Then let go and do not pray again.
Climb up, then back down on the far side. The achievement unlocks after you climb down.

achievements.description: Hit the piano against the wall 5 times.
achievements.summary: Make the piano in the @loc{Train Wreck} house hit the wall 5 times by moving the safe upstairs.

steps.text: Follow the main path to the house and go to the top floor, where the safe is.
Push the safe from one corner to another. Each move makes the piano below hit a wall. Repeat until the piano has hit 5 times.

achievements.description: Destroy every box at the station.
achievements.summary: Destroy every crate around the crane route at the @loc{Station}.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks while you use the crane. If it has not unlocked by the end of the crane section, you missed a crate. Replay the chapter from chapter select.

steps.text: While riding the crane through the @loc{Station}, lower the container onto every wooden crate below, including crates hidden under train carriages.

achievements.description: Drown in the frog pond 10 times.
achievements.summary: Drown 10 times in the frog water of the @loc{Pond} chapter.

steps.text: In the @loc{Pond}, jump into the frog pond water 10 times to drown.

achievements.description: Drown in the river in Tihon.
achievements.summary: Drown in the river 5 times in @loc{Tihon}.

steps.text: After leaving the @loc{Monastery}, go left and down the stairs to the cabin. The river is next to it.
Jump into the river 5 times to drown. Do this before you cross with the ferry.

achievements.description: Fall into the fish dryer 5 times.
achievements.summary: Fall off the platforms into the fish dryer 5 times in the @loc{Fish Factory}.

guide.context: Do this before the no-fall achievement. You cannot earn both in one run.

steps.text: At the first fish dryer room near the start of the @loc{Fish Factory}, let yourself fall off the platforms 5 times.

achievements.displayName: Like shooting fish in a barrel
achievements.description: Cross the fish dryer without falling.
achievements.summary: Cross the whole fish dryer section of the @loc{Fish Factory} without falling once.

guide.context: Earn the 5-fall achievement first, then restart the chapter from chapter select. The achievement unlocks when you drop into the water at the end of the section.

steps.text: Restart the @loc{Fish Factory} chapter.
Follow @npc{Ilya} closely and jump off each platform when he does. Slip between the hanging fish where they leave openings.
In the second dryer room, walk to the tail gap of the giant fish. Indika crouches on her own.
Continue until the story drops you into the water. Do not fall before that.

achievements.description: Finish the Fish Factory story scene.
achievements.summary: Reach the drying-clothes scene that ends the @loc{Fish Factory} chapter.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Fish Factory} to the end. The achievement unlocks during the story scene and cannot be missed.

achievements.description: Reach the scene where Ilya's hand is cut off.
achievements.summary: Watch the scene in the @loc{Stroboscopic Effect} chapter where @npc{Ilya}'s hand is cut off.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Stroboscopic Effect} chapter. The achievement unlocks in the story scene and cannot be missed.

achievements.summary: Find both bast shoes in the @loc{Spasov} chapter.

steps.text: Climb the elevator shaft. Before going outside, pull the lever to raise the elevator all the way, then climb to the very top and take the first @item{bast shoe}.
Go outside and cross the wooden beam to the balcony. Drop down onto it and take the second @item{bast shoe}.

achievements.summary: Finish the game by completing the @loc{Pawnshop} chapter and watching the credits.

guide.context: Do not skip the credits. Skipping them can stop the achievement from unlocking.

steps.text: Play through the @loc{Pawnshop} chapter to the end.
Let the full credits play, including the short scene after them, without skipping.

achievements.summary: Find the indecent book next to the chair on the upper scaffolds in the @loc{Cathedral of John of Damascus}.

steps.text: Early in the chapter, follow @npc{Ilya} up the scaffolds to the upper levels.
Find the chair on an upper level of the scaffolds and take the book beside it.

achievements.description: Pray for the dying man at the wrecked train.
achievements.summary: Pray beside the man impaled on the wrecked train in @loc{Train Wreck}.

steps.text: After the opening cutscene, walk to the impaled man and hold the pray button (right mouse button on PC) while facing him.

achievements.description: Pray while the dog chases you.
achievements.summary: Pray at the icon in the corner of the safe room during the dog chase in the @loc{Mill}.

guide.context: The room is the one the dog tries to break into during the chase.

steps.text: In the safe room, push the table into a corner and climb onto it.
Face the icon high in the corner and hold the pray button (right mouse button on PC).
